dedupe_keys.name: pharmaceutical last mile delivery time and distance matrices

description: This Zenodo archive supplies processed time and distance matrices for pharmaceutical last-mile delivery routing. A third-party logistics provider gave researchers access to its order-management system for nine daily delivery problems over roughly four to five weeks. Each daily instance involved about sixty to eighty-five stops and includes vehicle-capacity and delivery-time-window constraints. The public archive is CC BY 4.0. Its GitHub companion provides download and processing examples; those scripts do not establish a separate licensed simulation platform. Coverage is one company’s selected operating days; the actual delivery geography was not established from the public metadata. Matrices include estimated travel between stops beyond routes actually driven, so they are not all measured journeys. A reviewer-assessed use is benchmarking capacitated vehicle routing or comparing time-window service strategies. model-vroom is a related routing model, but no verified direct import was performed. No order records, archive or code payload was downloaded.
